readings.title: The Tent of Meeting
readings.subtitle: Surveying the Remaining Land at Shiloh
readings.text: [Joshua 18:1] And all the congregation of the children of Yisra’el assembled at Shiloh, and they set up <dn>את</dn> the Tent of Meeting there. And the land was subdued before them. [2] And there remained among the children of Yisra’el seven tribes which had not yet received <dn>את</dn> their inheritance. [3] And Yehoshua said to the children of Yisra’el, “How long are you going to neglect to go and possess <dn>את</dn> the land which <dn>YeHoVaH Elohim</dn> of your fathers has given you? [4] “Appoint three men for each tribe, and let me send them to rise up and go through the land and write a description of <dn>את</dn> it according to their inheritance, and come back to me. [5] “And they shall divide <dn>את</dn> it into seven portions – Yehudah stays in their border on the south, and the house of Yoseph stays in their border on the north. [6] “And you shall describe <dn>את</dn> the land in seven portions, and shall bring the description here to me, and I shall cast lots for you here before <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> our <dn>Elohim</dn>. [7] “But the Lewites have no portion among you, for the priesthood of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> is their inheritance. And Gad, and Re’uḇen, and half the tribe of Menashsheh have received their inheritance beyond the Yardĕn on the east, which Mosheh the servant of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> gave them.” [8] And the men rose up and went. And Yehoshua commanded <dn>את</dn> those who went to describe <dn>את</dn> the land, saying, “Go, walk through the land, and describe <dn>את</dn> it, and come back to me, that I might cast lots for you here before <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> in Shiloh.” [9] So the men went, and passed through the land, and wrote the description in a book according to cities in seven portions, and came to Yehoshua at the camp in Shiloh. [10] And Yehoshua cast lots for them in Shiloh before <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, and there Yehoshua divided <dn>את</dn> the land to the children of Yisra’el according to their divisions.

readings.title: The Inheritance of Binyamin
readings.subtitle: Boundaries Between Yehudah and Yoseph
readings.text: [Joshua 18:11] And the lot of the tribe of the children of Binyamin came up for their clans, and the border of their lot came out between the children of Yehudah and the children of Yoseph. [12] And their border on the north side began at the Yardĕn, and the border went up to the side of Yeriho on the north, and went up through the mountains westward, and ended at the Wilderness of Bĕyth Awen. [13] And the border went over from there toward Luz, to the side of Luz – that is Bĕyth Ěl – southward. And the border went down to Atroth Addar, by the hill that lies on the south side of Lower Bĕyth Ḥoron. [14] And the border reached and turned around to the west side south of the hill that lies before Bĕyth Ḥoron southward, and it ended at Qiryath Baʽal – that is Qiryath Yeʽarim – a city of the children of Yehudah. This is the west side. [15] And the south side began at the end of Qiryath Yeʽarim, and the border went out to the west, and went out to the fountain of the waters of Nephtoah. [16] And the border came down to the end of the mountain that lies before the Valley of the Son of Hinnom, which is in the Valley of the Repha’im on the north, and went down to the Valley of Hinnom, to the side of the Yeḇusite on the south, and went down to Ěn Rogĕl. [17] And it was drawn from the north, and went out to Ěn Shemesh, and went out toward Geliloth, which is opposite the Ascent of Adummim, and went down to the stone of Bohan the son of Re’uḇen, [18] and passed over to the side opposite Araḇah northward, and went down to Araḇah. [19] And the border passed over to the side of Bĕyth Ḥoglah northward, and the border ended at the north bay of the Salt Sea, at the south end of the Yardĕn. This is the southern border. [20] And the Yardĕn borders <dn>את</dn> it on the east side. This is the inheritance of the children of Binyamin, according to its surrounding borders, for their clans.

readings.title: The Cities of Binyamin
readings.subtitle: Including Yerushalayim
readings.text: [Joshua 18:21] And the cities of the tribe of the children of Binyamin, for their clans, were Yeriho, and Bĕyth Ḥoglah, and Ěmeq Qetsits, [22] and Bĕyth Araḇah, and Tsemarayim, and Bĕyth Ěl, [23] and Awwim, and Parah, and Ophrah, [24] and Kephar Ha-Ammoni, and Ophni, and Geḇa – twelve cities with their villages; [25] Giḇʽon, and Ramah, and Be’ĕroth, [26] and Mitspah, and Kephirah, and Motsah, [27] and Reqem, and Yirpe’ĕl, and Taralah, [28] and Tsela, Eleph, and Yeḇus – that is Yerushalayim – Giḇʽath, and Qiryath – fourteen cities with their villages. This is the inheritance of the children of Binyamin for their clans.

readings.title: The Inheritance of Shimʽon
readings.subtitle: Within the Portion of Yehudah
readings.text: [Joshua 19:1] And the second lot came out for Shimʽon, for the tribe of the children of Shimʽon, for their clans. And their inheritance was within the inheritance of the children of Yehudah. [2] And they had in their inheritance: Be’ĕrsheḇa, and Sheḇa, and Moladah, [3] and Ḥatsar Shuʽal, and Balah, and Etsem, [4] and Eltolad, and Bethul, and Ḥormah, [5] and Tsiqlag, and Bĕyth Markaḇoth, and Ḥatsar Susah, [6] and Bĕyth Leḇa’oth, and Sharuhen – thirteen cities and their villages; [7] Ayin, Rimmon, and Ether, and Ashan – four cities and their villages; [8] and all the villages that were around these cities as far as Baʽalath Be’ĕr, Ramah of the South. This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Shimʽon for their clans. [9] The inheritance of the children of Shimʽon was out of the portion of the children of Yehudah, for the share of the children of Yehudah was too much for them. And the children of Shimʽon inherited within their inheritance.

readings.title: The Inheritance of Zebulun
readings.text: [Joshua 19:10] And the third lot came up for the children of Zebulun according to their clans, and the border of their inheritance was as far as Sarid. [11] And their border went up toward the west and Maralah, and reached to Dabbasheth, and reached to the wadi that is before Yoqneʽam, [12] and turned from Sarid eastward toward the rising sun, to the border of Kisloth Taḇor, and went out to Daḇrath, and went up to Yaphiya, [13] and from there it passed over to the east, to Gath Ḥĕpher, to Eth Qatsin, and went out to Rimmon which bends toward Neʽah. [14] And the border went around <dn>את</dn> it on the north side of Ḥannathon, and it ended in the Valley of Yiphthaḥ Ěl, [15] and Qattath, and Nahalal, and Shimron, and Yidalah, and Bĕyth Leḥem – twelve cities with their villages. [16] This is the inheritance of the children of Zebulun according to their clans, these cities with their villages.

readings.title: The Inheritance of Yissaskar
readings.text: [Joshua 19:17] The fourth lot came out to Yissaskar, for the children of Yissaskar, for their clans. [18] And their territory went to Yizreʽĕl, and Kesulloth, and Shunem, [19] and Ḥapharayim, and Shi’on, and Anaḥarath, [20] and Rabbith, and Qishyon, and Ebets, [21] and Remeth, and Ěn Gannim, and Ěn Ḥaddah, and Bĕyth Pats-tsets. [22] And the border reached to Taḇor, and Shaḥatsimah, and Bĕyth Shemesh, and their border ended at the Yardĕn – sixteen cities with their villages. [23] This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Yissaskar for their clans, the cities and their villages.

readings.title: The Inheritance of Asher
readings.text: [Joshua 19:24] And the fifth lot came out for the tribe of the children of Asher for their clans. [25] And their territory was Ḥelqath, and Ḥali, and Beten, and Akshaph, [26] and Allammelek, and Amʽad, and Mish’al. And it reached to Karmel westward, and to Shihor Liḇnath. [27] And it turned toward the rising sun to Bĕyth Dagon, and reached to Zebulun and to the Valley of Yiphthaḥ Ěl northward and Bĕyth Ěmeq and Neʽi’ĕl, and went out to Kaḇul on the left, [28] and Eḇron, and Reḥoḇ, and Ḥammon, and Kanah, as far as Great Tsidon. [29] And the border turned to Ramah and to the strong city Tsor, and the border turned to Ḥosah, and ended at the sea from the coast to Akziḇ, [30] and Ummah, and Apheq, and Reḥoḇ – twenty-two cities with their villages. [31] This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Asher for their clans, these cities with their villages.

readings.title: The Inheritance of Naphtali
readings.text: [Joshua 19:32] The sixth lot came out to the children of Naphtali, for the children of Naphtali for their clans. [33] And their border was from Ḥeleph, from the terebinth tree in Tsaʽanannim, and Adami Neqeḇ, and Yaḇn’ĕl, as far as Laqqum, and it ended at the Yardĕn. [34] And the border turned westward to Aznoth Taḇor, and went out from there toward Ḥuqqoq, and reached to Zebulun on the south side, and to Asher on the west side, and to Yehudah by the Yardĕn toward the rising sun. [35] And the fenced cities are Tsiddim, Tsĕr, and Ḥammath, Raqqath, and Kinnereth, [36] and Adamah, and Ramah, and Ḥatsor, [37] and Qedesh, and Edreʽi, and Ěn Ḥatsor, [38] and Yir’on, and Migdal Ěl, Ḥorem, and Bĕyth Anath, and Bĕyth Shemesh – nineteen cities with their villages. [39] This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Naphtali for their clans, the cities and their villages.

readings.title: The Inheritance of Dan
readings.text: [Joshua 19:40] The seventh lot came out for the tribe of the children of Dan for their clans. [41] And the border of their inheritance was Tsor’ah, and Eshta’ol, and Ir Shemesh, [42] and Shaʽalabbin, and Ayalon, and Yithlah, [43] and Ĕlon, and Timnathah, and Eqron, [44] and Elteqĕh, and Gibbethon, and Baʽalath, [45] and Yehuḏ, and Benĕ-Beraq, and Gath Rimmon, [46] and Mĕy Yarqon, and Raqqon, with the border before Yapho. [47] And the border of the children of Dan went out from them, and the children of Dan went up to fight against Leshem and captured <dn>את</dn> it. And they smote <dn>את</dn> it with the edge of the sword, and possessed <dn>את</dn> it, and dwelt in it, and called Leshem, Dan, after the name of Dan their father. [48] This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Dan for their clans, these cities with their villages.
